تفيهقت (form IIq)
# تَفَيْهَقْتُ (tafayhaqtu) /ta.faj.haq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَفَيْهَقَ (tafayhaqa)
# تَفَيْهَقْتَ (tafayhaqta) /ta.faj.haq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَفَيْهَقَ (tafayhaqa)
# تَفَيْهَقْتِ (tafayhaqti) /ta.faj.haq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَفَيْهَقَ (tafayhaqa)
# تَفَيْهَقَتْ (tafayhaqat) /ta.faj.ha.qat/: t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
